title: Lean Schrodinger Derivation
description: Lean 4 formalization of a thirteen-stage conditional nonrelativistic Schrodinger handoff. Starting from a native chi mass readout and an explicit free-Dirac mass-shell hypothesis, the release selects the positive-energy branch, removes rest energy, rationalizes the kinetic term, bounds the explicit relativistic correction, derives a local chi-dependent potential, and proves the textbook Schrodinger operator identity for a single Fourier plane-wave mode in natural units. It does not independently derive the mass shell from the lattice action, prove an arbitrary-wavefunction position-space PDE, Born's rule, or a complete quantum theory.
